tagline.en_US: darktable is an open source photography workflow application and raw developer. A virtual lighttable and darkroom for photographers. It manages your digital negatives in a database, lets you view them through a zoomable lighttable and enables you to develop raw images and enhance them.

description.en_US: Darktable is an open-source photography workflow application and raw developer designed as a virtual lighttable and darkroom. It organizes digital negatives within a database and provides a zoomable lighttable to view and sort files. Users can non-destructively develop, process, and enhance raw camera images.
